{"id":1516101501,"question_id":6,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1737485486,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1516101501/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Zigzag Conversion","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string convert(string s, int numRows) {\n        int row = 0;\n        int i =0;\n        bool direction = 1;\n        vector<string> ans(numRows);\n\n        while(i < s.size())\n        {\n            if(direction == 1)\n            {\n                while(row < numRows && i<s.size())\n                {\n                    ans[row].push_back(s[i]);\n                    row++; i++;\n                }\n                row = numRows - 2;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                while(row>=0 && i<s.size())\n                {\n                    ans[row].push_back(s[i]);\n                    row--; i++;\n                }\n                row = 1;\n            }\n            direction = !direction ;\n        }\n        string final =\"\";\n        for(auto st : ans)\n        {\n            final += st;\n        }\n    return final;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"zigzag-conversion","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":223}
